newsitem.title: USA: GE NAMES EUGENE MURPHY AS VICE CHAIRMAN.
newsitem.headline: GE NAMES EUGENE MURPHY AS VICE CHAIRMAN.

text.p: General Electric Co said Friday that Eugene Murphy, the president and chief executive of its GE Aircraft Engines unit, has been named Vice Chairman and elected to the GE board.
GE said Murphy has led its $7 billion Aircraft Engines business since 1993 and also was chief executive of its GE Aerospace until its 1993 merger with Martin Marietta Corp.
In his new position, Murphy joins Chairman John Welch and vice chairmen Paolo Fresco and John Opie in GE's Corporate Executive Office.
GE said James McNerney, president and chief executive of its of GE Lighting unit, will succeed Murphy as president and chief executive of GE Aircraft Engines.
David Calhoun, president and chief executive of GE Transportation Systems, will succeed McNerney as GE senior vice president and president and chief executive of GE Lighting.

John Rice, president of GE Plastics-Pacific, will succeed Calhoun as president and chief executive at GE Transportation Systems, and Paul McBride, general manager of GE Plastics Cycolac Resin Business, will succeed Rice as President of GE Plastics-Pacific, GE said.
